fields.title: Affiliate-ready product record
fields.description: One row per qualifying product: Blibli's own fields passed through verbatim, plus parsed content (clean selling points, short description, full-size images), tracking links and a ready-to-post caption. IMPORTANT: `shareLink` and `trackedUrl` are tracking/deep links carrying your UTM values - they are NOT commission-attributing affiliate links, because Blibli's affiliate commission API requires an authenticated account (it returns 401 without one). Every type is nullable since optional enrichments may be off.

_input.title: Input
_input.description: The search term or category that produced this record.

_scrapedAt.title: Scraped at
_scrapedAt.description: UTC ISO 8601 timestamp when this record was scraped.

_error.title: Error
_error.description: Present only on failure rows (INVALID_INPUT, BLOCKED_AFTER_RETRIES, UPSTREAM_SHAPE_CHANGED, EMPTY_RESULT).

_errorDetail.title: Error detail
_errorDetail.description: Free-form diagnostic detail, present only alongside _error.

merchantCode.title: Seller code
merchantCode.description: Blibli merchant code of the seller.

isOfficialStore.title: Official store
isOfficialStore.description: Whether the seller is an official brand store - the safest products to promote.

discountPercent.title: Discount %
discountPercent.description: Discount off list price - the hook for a promo post.

rating.title: Rating
rating.description: Product star rating (the precise decimal value where Blibli exposes it).

reviewCount.title: Review count
reviewCount.description: Number of reviews behind the rating.

soldCount.title: Units sold
soldCount.description: Total units sold - the strongest available proof of demand.

sellingPoints.title: Selling points
sellingPoints.description:
Blibli's `uniqueSellingPoint` blob parsed into clean bullet strings, with its literal \n
separators and markup removed.

shortDescription.title: Short description
shortDescription.description: Compact blurb assembled from the selling points, trimmed to fit a caption. Falls back to the product name when a listing has no selling points.

seoDescription.title: SEO description
seoDescription.description: Blibli's own meta description for the product. Only present when 'Enrich from product page' is on.

primaryImage.title: Primary image
primaryImage.description: First product image at the requested size - the one to attach to a post.

images.title: Images
images.description: All product images at the requested size.

imageCount.title: Image count
imageCount.description: How many images the listing carries.

warrantyType.title: Warranty type
warrantyType.description: Warranty class, e.g. RESMI (official). Only present with page enrichment.

warrantyText.title: Warranty text
warrantyText.description: The exact warranty statement, e.g. 'Garansi resmi 2 tahun' - quotable in a post. Only present with page enrichment.

warrantyDuration.title: Warranty duration
warrantyDuration.description: Warranty length, e.g. '2 tahun'. Only present with page enrichment.

hasOfficialWarranty.title: Has official warranty
hasOfficialWarranty.description: True when the warranty type is RESMI. Only present with page enrichment.

stock.title: Stock
stock.description: Units available. Only present with page enrichment.

productUrl.title: Product URL
productUrl.description: Clean product URL with Blibli's own session tracking query (ds, source, sid, metaData) stripped.

trackedUrl.title: Tracked URL
trackedUrl.description: Product URL with your utm_campaign / utm_source / utm_medium appended. Built locally, always present, and works with no redirect.

shareLink.title: Blibli share link
shareLink.description: Blibli's own OneLink short link (blibli.onelink.me/...) minted via their public endpoint, redirecting to the product with your UTM values attached. Null when link generation is off or a mint failed. A tracking link, not a commission link.

caption.title: Ready-to-post caption
caption.description: Caption rendered from your template with this product's name, price, discount, rating, sold count, description and link filled in.

query.title: Query
query.description: The search term or category code that produced this record.

rankInQuery.title: Rank in query
rankInQuery.description: 1-based position in Blibli's own result ordering before filtering.

officialWarrantyFilterApplied.title: Official warranty filter applied
officialWarrantyFilterApplied.description: Whether the run restricted results to products with an official warranty.
